name: ClauseGuard MCP
tagline: Commercial playbook comparison, Word Track Changes (.docx) formatter, draft diff, and security questionnaires (informational checklist only — not legal advice).
description: ClauseGuard helps operations, procurement, and deal desks compare commercial agreement drafts (MSAs, NDAs, SaaS subscriptions, data privacy addendums, and BAAs) against standard commercial checklists. It highlights clauses that differ from the selected playbook, formats suggested revisions into a downloadable Microsoft Word (.docx) file with native Track Changes, compares draft versions, and drafts customer security questionnaire responses. Informational checklist utility only — does not provide legal advice.

privacy_and_data_handling.data_retention: Zero model training on customer agreements. Document artifacts are held ephemerally in memory solely for your immediate Word (.docx) download.
privacy_and_data_handling.encryption: TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest
